verdict.rationale: Dropbox offers file deletion/restore windows (180 days or 1 year depending on plan) and a Files API to programmatically delete files, giving basic data retention/deletion control, but there is no evidence of AI-specific data retention policies, no controls over how data is used/retained by Dropbox's AI features (Dash, AI summarization), and no documentation on deletion of AI-derived data or opt-out of AI training. missing for 10: AI-specific retention/deletion policy docs, controls over data used by Dash/AI features, enterprise data governance/audit trail for deletion, independent verification of deletion behavior.
